title: Law to require city agencies to train staff on immigration rules
summary: This bill would require city agencies, including the NYPD, Department of Correction and Department of Probation, to train employees, contractors and subcontractors on existing laws limiting cooperation with immigration enforcement and non-local law enforcement requests. Agencies would also have to publish implementation plans and compliance protocols explaining how staff should follow these laws, including policies on responding to requests from federal immigration authorities. These requirements would take effect by January 1, 2027.
